title: separateTypeDeclarations
responsibility: Separates generated interfaces and named type aliases into sibling type files, preserving type imports and exports.

inputs.name: separateTypeDeclarations.files
inputs.description: An ordered list of planned files with paths and source contents. A file is split only when its path ends in .ts but not .d.ts and its top-level statements include an interface or type alias plus a class, function, or variable declaration.

examples.contents:
export interface FeatureOptions { enabled: boolean; }

export function createFeature(options: FeatureOptions) { return options.enabled; }

outputs.name: separateTypeDeclarations
outputs.description: The returned planned file list, with each eligible implementation rewritten to import its named declarations from a sibling .types.ts file and re-export them for compatibility. Files without both a runtime declaration and at least one interface or type alias, including non-.ts and .d.ts files, are retained without splitting.
